title: Unit Event — Grow Glorious Glow — Episode5 Me Back Then

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! haven't received any job offers in a while, but one day, an email arrives for Shizuku. It invites her to audition for popular cosmetics brand Grand Fleur's new commercial...

rows.Speaker: Oikawa
rows.Line: You wouldn't believe how dazzling she was back then. She was just like Hagiyama. No, even more brilliant...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Mr. Oikawa said I used to have a dazzling aura when I was still with Cheerful * Days...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's why he asked me to audition.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (And yet, I haven't been able to live up to his expectations...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (If things continue like this, then in the worst case scenario, I might get dropped from the commercial entirely.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I have to stop that from happening.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But is it even possible for me to regain the aura I once had...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How would I go about doing that...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I might be able to learn something by watching videos of myself from back then.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There should be some of me practicing on my own saved to my tablet—

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Miku, it's you...
What brings you here all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<I'm sorry if I startled you!
But I came to ask about your fitting session, since you said it was today.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<That Hagiyama girl was also there, right?
So, how did everything go?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, so...
I'd say it went well, since I had a chance to hear about her thought process and resolve.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<I see...
And this Mr. Oikawa really said that...?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which is why I was thinking about watching some videos of myself, to discover the truth behind what that “aura” of mine was.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <In that case, Shizuku, would it be alright if we watched together?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Not only should having an extra set of eyes help you solve this problem, I'd like to learn more about the old you.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Then, let's watch together, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'll try playing it now.
Pressing this button should turn the power on...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? It isn't lighting up for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Oh...
Could its battery have run out?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, you might be right!
Let's see... The charger for it should be...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you for being so patient, Miku.
I should be able to play it now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes.
I think I took it to make sure my form looked okay.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
This really takes me back...
This was the first song I learned after becoming the lead.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. It's obvious that you're trying your very best.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Back then, I wasn't sure if I'd do a good job as the lead. I'm sure that worry showed clearly on my face.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Right...
That reminds me of what you said about having to struggle for a little while.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, because I felt that I didn't have the skills or mindset the role demanded of me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I feel so embarrassed looking back now...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm struggling to keep up with the song, and every motion I take looks so unrefined...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes, I can see why the current you would feel that way.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But I'm seeing more than just that.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <I know I can do much better...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Just now, for a second there...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Tell me, Shizuku.
What was going through your mind during this practice?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I felt that I had to absolutely shine when I performed this dance...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I kept telling myself that I had to succeed no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Looking at your eyes here, Shizuku, I can tell that there's strong resolve at work here.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This conversation has helped remind me of how I really felt back then.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Back then, I was constantly worried about how I'd actually do as the lead. But...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's also why I was so desperate.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Shizuku, you have to get to your next appointment. How are you feeling? Good...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, yes... It's that magazine interview, correct?
I've made sure to memorize all the answers to their questions, so I should be more than ready for it.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Okay, but... In the event that they do decide to throw you a curveball, Arisa will be there to help. So, feel free to ask for assistance whenever.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (The lead is supposed to be a group's central pillar.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(But I'm always making everyone worry...
I'm always having to ask for their help...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Doesn't that mean I'm not really cut out for...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hang on...
You're all going to be joining Cheerful * Days soon, yes? The others told me the news.

rows.Speaker: Junior Idol
rows.Line:
Yes!
Starting next month, we'll be joining you for lessons!

rows.Speaker: Junior Idol
rows.Line:
A-And...
I'm so happy about getting to join Cheerful * Days...!

rows.Speaker: Junior Idol
rows.Line: Cheerful * Days is the reason I love idols so much...! I've been doing everything I can in order to become an amazing performer like you and the others!

rows.Speaker: Junior Idol
rows.Line: We look forward to working with you, and we promise to do our very best in order to not let you all down!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I look forward to working with all of you as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(They look so honest and pure...
I can tell that they've worked very hard to get here...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'm the lead now, so I'm responsible for these girls' futures.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I can't show any weakness in front of them.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (As terrifying it is that I'm responsible for this group's future...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I have to keep practicing. Regardless of how scared I am.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I have to keep finding ways to improve...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I have to lead Cheerful * Days to the top and clear a path towards a bright future for us all!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. Between my responsibilities and the quality which was expected of me, I ended up struggling quite a lot...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But that pressure and the expectations placed on me also pushed me to become better.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Which would explain why you're shining so much in this video...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I've been coddling myself since joining MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The others, as well as our fans, have accepted me for “who I really am”.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm standing here now because of their kindness. But if you look at the other side of that coin...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You'll see a person who thinks she doesn't need to work hard on her own. Because those around her have told her that it's okay to lean on your friends...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I've become so accustomed to this new environment that I've allowed myself to become soft.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's no wonder that Mr. Oikawa thinks I've lost my aura...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I don't have to lead our group.
I don't feel compelled to shine brighter than my peers. I don't have that strong resolve anymore.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But if you know all this now, then there's only one thing left to do!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I have to regain what I had before—
No, I need to face this job with even greater resolve than that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
It's my turn to lead MORE MORE JUMP!
I have to make the commitment to become better than ever, no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm going to shine brighter than everyone else, and blow Mr. Oikawa and the others away...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you for your help, Miku.
I know exactly what I need to do now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'll be looking forward to seeing your commercial, Shizuku!>
